name: DialogButton
purpose: Action button in a sheet or confirm dialog. Carries the dialog keyboard roles: accept on Enter, cancel on Escape, and instead for a secondary action. Sits in the sheet footer grid. Its tone axis is removed: the look comes from the Button variant (critique: one axis).
base: Radix AlertDialog Action and Cancel (shadcn AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel); instead is a plain Button

props.name: role
props.description: Which keyboard and dismissal role the button plays. accept runs onActivate; cancel dismisses with action dismiss; instead resolves with insteadId.

props.name: insteadId
props.description: The id the instead role resolves with.

props.name: variant
props.description: Passed through to Button. Cancel and instead default to neutral; accept is neutral as recorded, primary proposed; destructive accept is danger.

props.name: onActivate
props.description: Handler. The caller owns the empty-field guard (focus the field, do nothing) and the trimmed text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Passed to Button. Not used for the empty-field guard (see open).

role: button (AlertDialog Action for accept, AlertDialog Cancel for cancel, plain button for instead)
keyboard: Enter activates the accept button when focus is not in a text field (reference rule). Escape dismisses the sheet as cancel. Tab cycles through the footer. Danger accept fires on Enter at once with no guard in the reference.
platform: Desktop: each sheet is its own window with no backdrop; Escape closes the window. Web: a modal dialog; the backdrop style is not decided. The button look is the same on both.
open: (1) Accept look: the reference uses neutral for the forward action of create, rename and move; the Filter panel Done uses blue. The decision says blue is for primary action, so accept becomes primary as proposed. Confirm; it changes the reference look. (2) Danger accept: Enter confirms deletion at once with no guard. Propose that a destructive sheet starts focus on Cancel. Confirm. (3) Empty-field behaviour: A's catalogue has both a guard (focus the field, do nothing) and a disabled accept. Guard kept, disabled not used; confirm. (4) The instead target is not verified: Import JSON leads somewhere beyond closing that is not shown in the code read. (5) Width: Cancel is 84px in the reference (measured) against code min-w-24 = 96px. Measured 84px used, so DialogButton uses lg with min-width 84px. Confirm.
